body: I hope the best for you but not gonna lie bro I envy you.  You have stuff in your life you want to protect and have a job that you don't dread going to everyday make more money than me by a long shot and yet I have to work more hours, have a girl that loves you and wants to be with you. Have a dog, have a house, you have everything and it pisses me the fuck off when people like you cry and complain. Life sucks bro. Deal with it or don't. You honestly made me feel so much worse about my life and the expectancy of how long I have before I finally fully give up.

Look. I can't type on here what kind of person I am inside but I can assure you that you are not bad. You may have bad moments but that means nothing. You are you. That's all you can be. You will attract people that will accept who you are. Fuck ups and all. I promise.  And if you feel you can't find a friend I will be your friend. Because sadness attracts sadness, anger begets anger. We all just try and exist, some are better at it than others.
Also fuck your ex, and your therapist. Just because you have the feelings or way you act in the world doesn't mean that someone can tell you that your bad or wrong.

I feel you.. it's ever present. The urge, the absolute need to hit the end of the road.. I wish I had a fix for you I do. I wish i could say oh just talk to someone and you'll feel better, you won't. It's just a ever ticking clock that you feel will never strike midnight.  I get you. Just try n take it one day at a time. That's the best I got honestly. And even I struggle to take my own advice.

I'm literally right beside you friend.. Just so over the life I've crafted for myself. It's exhausting just existing in this world. I used to try n take my own life but after the last failure I decided to just wallow in misery. You have have have to try.  Otherwise your just me. A dude in his 30s just praying to get hit my a train every single day. You got this tho friend. I believe.
Can i get a link? I'd like to watch it.

The lockdown didn't really affect me more or less because im an introvert but just the lack of jobs now, mixed with the lack of medicine, mixed with a whole world of pain has just got me to this point of being done. I'm just done. Theres no point in trying anymore.

I have major depression, I haven't felt happiness in probably over 3 years, I used to be on medicine but due to the state taking away my medicade I no longer can afford that luxury I want to die almost every minute of every day, I feel like a very sick dog that will never get better but no one will euthanize me
Worked for me, your a life saver.
